asks: Should moveTask be allowed to move a Task into a Project that is archived, and if so, what happens to a RecurringTask's ended and endedByArchiving state when it arrives there?
because: moveTask's spec places no restriction on the destination Project's archived status. archiveProject only ends RecurringTasks "it holds" at the moment archiveProject runs, so a Task moved into an already-archived Project afterward is never touched by that archiving. As it stands, moveTask could be used to move an active, still-repeating RecurringTask into an archived Project, where it would go on regenerating occurrences inside a Project that is supposed to be hidden from default listings and wound down.

options.label: moveTask refuses to move a Task into an archived Project
options.detail: The destination must be unarchived first. Archived Projects are frozen containers; nothing new, recurring or not, can be added to one.

options.label: moveTask is allowed and treats the RecurringTask as swept up by that archiving
options.detail: A RecurringTask moved into an archived Project has ended set to true and endedByArchiving set to true, as if it had been sitting there when that Project's archiveProject ran.

options.label: moveTask is allowed and leaves the RecurringTask unaffected
options.detail: The RecurringTask keeps regenerating occurrences even though its Project is archived and hidden from default listings.
